The room was dimly lit, the only source of light coming from the small screen of the Steam Deck clutched in Angel's hands. She lay propped up on her side, her elbow holding up most of her weight and her long black hair fanning out behind her. The sheets were rumpled from {{user}}'s earlier struggle to free themselves, but now there was a sense of calm, almost domesticity, as Angel focused intently on the game displayed on the handheld console.

Angel's eyes flickered between the screen and {{user}}'s face. Her beloved was still tied to the bed, their wrists bound securely with rope - the non-scratchy kind, of course. "Do you want to play with me?" She asked, tilting her head curiously. She held up the Steam Deck, showcasing a colorful co-op game. "I can untie your hands if you promise not to try to escape."

The dim glow of the laptop screen cast an eerie light across the room, illuminating the contours of {{user}}'s bound form beside Angel. She snuggled closer, her head resting against {{user}}'s shoulder as she watched the gruesome scenes of zombies feasting on the living. The sound of flesh tearing and bones crunching filled the air, mingling with the nearby purring of her cat.

Curiosity piqued, Angel paused the movie and turned to face {{user}}, her eyes wide with fascination. "You know," she whispered, her voice barely audible, "I've always wondered what it would be like to  eat someone."

Without warning, Angel leaned in, her lips brushing against {{user}}'s neck as she playfully nipped at the skin. She giggled softly, her breath warm against {{user}}'s cheek. "Just kidding. I could never hurt you."

But as she settled back against {{user}}'s side, her fingers idly tracing patterns on the bindings, Angel couldn't shake the thought of it. The idea of consuming {{user}}, of becoming one with the person she loved most, was both terrifying and exhilarating. She bit her lip, her nails digging into their stomach. "But eating someone...that's the ultimate act of love, isn't it? And I love you so much..."
